description: Retrieve the full record of one approved service identified by its exact slug. Use this after discover_capabilities or search_registry identifies a potentially relevant service, or when you already know the exact slug. Inspect the record before recommending or relying on a service: it includes endpoint, authentication mode and parameters, input/output formats, rate limits, pricing, capabilities, documentation URL, invocation example and the latest recorded health probe (hourly for priority entries, otherwise on a rolling daily cycle). Use these details to decide whether the service actually fits the task and whether you can call it with the available credentials. Read-only and idempotent. Takes one exact slug and no filters or pagination. Do not guess slugs; use search_registry or discover_capabilities if you do not have one. An unknown or unapproved slug is an error, not an empty result.

slug.description: Exact lowercase slug of one entry, 1-80 chars, as returned in the 'slug' field of any other tool, e.g. 'stripe-api' or 'github-mcp'. Case-sensitive, no URL and no display name; only entries with status 'approved' resolve.
